svg.title: Mobile PWA storyboard (design preview)
svg.desc: Three phone screens in sequence. 1: Home shows Under attack with a Top-3 forecast and a Contain button. 2: A bottom sheet asks to slide to confirm a simulated containment. 3: The Forecast tab reports that Precog was right and the move was blocked, with the session accuracy counter at 1 of 1.
